<translate>
<!--T:1-->
'''Evasion techniques''' are utility moves that help you escape, reposition or turn a fight around: blinding flashes, afterimages, teleports, a healing nap and a roar that pushes everyone back. They activate as soon as you press the slot key and share a short lockout with each other.
</translate>

<translate>
== How evasion techniques work == <!--T:2-->
</translate>
{{Main|Techniques}}
<translate>
<!--T:3-->
* Evasion techniques must be equipped in a technique slot, and need an empty main hand, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]] skill and at least 5% Power Release.
* After using one, '''all''' your evasion techniques share a short lockout: the technique's duration + 3 seconds.
* They gain experience every time you use them. Spend it on '''duration''' (+2.5% per level, up to +50%) and '''cooldown''' upgrades. Sleep Recovery's duration is fixed, so it only has cooldown upgrades.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:14-->
'''Sleep Recovery''' is a Majin technique: any race can learn it from Majin Buu, but only a Majin can equip it in a technique slot (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques#Learning techniques|Techniques]]). [[Special:MyLanguage/Kid Buu|Kid Buu]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Kuu|Majin Kuu]] also use it in the story: they take a 7-second nap that heals up to 60% of their max health.
</translate>

<translate>
== Evasion techniques not taught by default == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
No master offers these in the default lists. Server owners can add [[Special:MyLanguage/Dimensional Warp|Dimensional Warp]] to a master's list, and admins can grant either with {{Command|/dmztech add}}.
</translate>
